visual.title: Two families of curves, always at right angles
visual.caption: Blue is Re f, teal is Im f. Cauchy-Riemann makes the families perpendicular wherever f' is not zero, and at a critical point neither has a tangent to be perpendicular to.

predict.question: Choose the conjugate map, which is not analytic. Do the two families still cross at a right angle?
options: No, the angles stop being right
predict.explain: Orthogonality is a consequence of the Cauchy-Riemann equations, not of drawing two families of curves.
